pages.title: Artisan Legacy
pages.text: $(bold)Max Level:$(r) I$(br2)$(bold)Applicable:$(r) Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels$(br2)$(bold)Effect:$(r) The tool $(italic)remembers$() mined block types (up to 5 types), mines same-type blocks faster (up to 2× speed), and has a chance for an extra drop (up to ~20%). Data persists in the tool NBT through dropping / storing.$(br2)$(bold)Mutually Exclusive:$(r) Unbreaking, Durability Boost, Made in China.$(br2)$(bold)Obtainment:$(r) Structure Chests, Villager Trades (treasure enchantment — unavailable from the enchanting table).
